title: Quadratic circuit output-sensitive adapter
statement: Given a binary encoding of packed Boolean circuits, the quadratic circuit output-sensitive adapter is the three-query output-sensitive adapter formed using that encoding, the circuit's quadratic four-query semantic PCPP reduction, and the reduction's positive query-count property.
caveat: The target adapter and reduction are referenced by name but their definitions and parameters are not included in the supplied snippet, so their full mathematical content cannot be stated here.
